generations.name: 1. Generation (NU7) Facelift
generations.notes: Facelift presented Nov 2021, on sale in Germany from early 2022. Standard rear bench: 521 / 1630 l. With optional VarioFlex rear seats: up to 588 l (seats slid forward), 1605 l with backrests folded and 1810 l with the seats removed. Wheelbase 2638 mm with front-wheel drive and 2630 mm with 4x4 (one source gives 2625 mm for the Sportline). Other sources give a height of 1624 or 1632 mm depending on trim and roof rails. No PHEV or BEV is offered. No published load-floor measurements were found.

generations.notes: On sale in Germany from 03/2024. Height 1656 mm (Skoda data sheet, at kerb weight); other sources give 1674-1679 mm depending on variant and roof rails. 5-seater: 910 / 2105 l. 7-seater option (combustion engines only, not the iV): 340 l with all three rows up and 845 l with the 3rd row folded; the 7-seat folded maximum was not found. The official press kit gives 835 / 2065 l for the 5-seater (835 l is with the sliding rear bench moved forward). ADAC lists 650 l and angurten.de lists 720 l as the normal value, presumably with the bench in a different position. The 7-seater (option) has 765 l with the 3rd row folded, 2005 l maximum and about 270 l with all rows up. Height 1660 mm (ADAC, Sportline 4x4); AutoScout24 gives 1671 mm or more for other trims. No PHEV was offered.

data.notes: Lean pass following the user's 80/20 request: 11 of the 12 allowed WebSearch calls were used. Trunk volumes and main dimensions come from official Skoda data sheets or press kits where available, otherwise from ADAC, InsideEVs and carwow. Enyaq Coupé was added as a separate suv-coupe model. Kamiq (small SUV) and Epiq (upcoming small BEV) were not added because they belong to a smaller segment and are probably covered in another list. Where no separate source was found for a powertrain, the base trunk value is used; the only confirmed smaller trunk is the Kodiaq iV PHEV (745/1945 l against 910/2105 l). Kodiaq 1st gen: the official 835 l figure is with the sliding rear bench forward; ADAC lists 650 l and angurten lists 720 l. For a conservative simulation, consider a lower value. Power figures for most variants come from known German price-list designations and were not individually verified in this pass; values I was unsure of are set to null. Kodiaq 2nd gen and Enyaq heights vary by source (by up to about 20 mm).
